description: Searches published catalog components. The first candidate includes verified pins when available; other candidates may omit them. Reuse returned IDs, pins and facts; call get_part only when the selected candidate lacks needed pins or facts. Supplied filters apply together; query ranks matching candidates, while factQuery only selects cached facts for those candidates. An optional boardRef applies that board’s strict Part List restriction, when enabled. Check candidates against the requested component type and specifications. If results are unrelated, make at most two retries for that part using a simpler component name or a relevant category from the input schema. Preserve required specifications and explicit restrictions, including any boardRef Part List restriction, on every retry. If no suitable part is found, report that you could not find a suitable part rather than claiming the catalog lacks it.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

factQuery.description: Cached-fact terms only; requires query. Omit for filter-only searches. It never changes which parts match.

jlcpcbBasic.description: Basic-only when true; otherwise leave unset.

limit.description: Maximum catalog candidates to return, from 1 to 20; defaults to 3.

mountingType.description: smt: surface mount; tht: through-hole; mixed: both.

package.description: Exact catalog label; use query for package families.

query.description: PCB selection terms: MPN, manufacturer, description or package family. For exact MPNs omit unverified categories unless user-required. Preserve explicit filters and Part Lists; factQuery does not select parts. Required when factQuery is supplied.

name: search_parts
title: Search published parts
